Cadre AI is an AI strategy and implementation firm that helps you go "From AI Confusion to AI Confidence." We help you pinpoint the right AI opportunities, implement them seamlessly, and deliver real business impact.

Here's how we work:

**Find.** We identify high-ROI AI use cases department by department across your business.

**Prepare.** We transform your team from AI-hesitant to AI-ambitious, and set up the right tools, data, and processes.

**Implement.** We build AI workflows and agents that unlock real ROI—and we train your team so they know when to rely on AI and when to lead without it.

We're focused on using AI to drive real revenue growth and improve EBITDA, and we've delivered high-ROI use cases across 50+ companies. We work with companies of all sizes, and we're an Official OpenAI Service Partner and Anthropic partner.

Want to explore what's possible for your business? You can talk to an AI Strategist at cadre.ai, or reach out to hello@gocadre.ai.

Cadre offers four core services:

- **AI Strategy** — The AI Transformation Intensive, a 45-day program that takes you from zero clarity to a prioritized roadmap your team can execute, with ROI estimates and a 3-year plan.
- **AI Leadership & Facilitation** — Transform executives and teams from AI-hesitant to AI-ambitious through sessions ranging from 1-hour virtual kickoffs to 2-day intensives, where you work on your own problems.
- **AI Engineering** — Connect your systems, automate workflows, and multiply impact by solving business problems with the right combination of existing tools, smart automation, and custom AI agents.
- **AI Agents** — Build everything from simple prompts and assistants to full-fledged AI agents, including voice agents that handle intake, qualification, support, and internal routing.

Cadre goes department by department to identify and implement AI workflows that unlock real ROI, and trains your team how to use AI effectively.
